limitations: This is a historical state paper application, not BenefitsCal UI/API field names or current eligibility policy.
Stable keys are analyst-created identifiers; labels are paper-derived summaries, not asserted exact live labels.
Program symbols were not exhaustively mapped; applicable program conditions require current verification.
Required/optional statements describe only explicit paper wording; no live validation flags inferred.
Repeatable paper rows do not impose online array limits.
